github_actions.meaning: Structural checks passed at the pre-tribunal head. This does not prove implementation, authority, security, migration, or outsider operation.

structural_validator_checks: JSON parseability and four top-level schema metadata keys

evidence: Quirk Core is named as owner inside a quirk-os repository without a canonical identity-stack or repository-topology decision.
Normative terms such as Strange Intact, Canonball, Quirk Way, Poison, Quirk Mutual, Spanknasty, and Quirk Taxes lack canonical IDs and definitions in this PR.
Only LedgerTransition, ProposedMove, ResearchClaim, and MediaDerivative schemas exist.
Receipt, Authority, Eval, Gate, Outcome, Capability, AgentSkill, Challenge, Comment, Poison, Forgetting, Release, and queue runtime contracts are prose-only.
No schema instances or fixtures are validated.
Authority modes are named, but no authority manifest, owner IDs, resolution algorithm, CODEOWNERS, waiver policy, or risk-scoped delegation exists.
Repository write permission is not distinguished from semantic authority.
Bryan's founder authority, personal preferences, operator authority, and tenant authority are not partitioned.
Research and Top Minds are prose inventories without typed source records, preserved primary artifacts, claim-level citations, contradiction packets, or adoption receipts.
Provider state and selection rationale live outside the repository.
The validator checks file existence, JSON parsing, six sentences, eleven prompt IDs, and placeholder strings.
Known missing release requirements do not currently make CI fail.
No Ledger Fuckery Detector fixtures, receipt reconstruction, queue concurrency, stale-write, idempotency, projection drift, or poison recurrence tests exist.
No threat model, hostile-document tests, secret contract, rights-sensitive forgetting implementation, non-resurrection test, or provider access policy exists.
Google Drive and Supabase boundaries are described but not versioned or tested.
No executable receipt envelope, provider manifest, projection rebuild, or cross-system fixture exists.
Supabase is live, Vercel has no quirk-os project, and Cloudflare live account state is unverified; the repository encodes none of those facts.
No executable eval definitions, task bank, reference solutions, repeated-trial policy, grader calibration, adversarial cases, or outcome comparison exists.
The Ship It Without Bryan prompt exists only as prose.

Architecture prose is strong, but there is no quickstart, install contract, operator guide, runbook, ADR, migration guide, changelog, license, contributing guide, security policy, or failure-recovery procedure.
The Drive work plane is not reconstructable from Git alone.
Distinctive language survives, but no calibrated rubric separates useful Quirk specificity from Bryan-only taste, inaccessible jargon, or ornamental profanity.
A voice-neutral conformant implementation is not defined.

The tribunal could orient conceptually but could not install a runtime, execute an example, trace a real authority decision, challenge state, follow a migration, recover a failure, or extend a capability.
Target operators are undefined.
Fifteen hidden-context Proposed Moves remain unresolved.
